Georgia has enacted 5 AI-related laws. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Georgia

5 laws this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • HR43: Artificial intelligence deepfakes; growing danger to election integrity, public trust, and the people of Georgia; recognize passed 2026-06-22

    This House resolution recognizes that artificial intelligence deepfakes pose a serious and growing danger to election integrity, public trust, and the people of Georgia. It encourages the study and enactment of legislation to require clear disclosure of artificial intelligence generated content in political communications and to provide meaningful recourse for Georgians harmed by deceptive deepfakes in elections. It also affirms the House's commitment to protecting Georgia voters from fabricated and deceptive artificial intelligence generated content and directs the Clerk to distribute copies.

  • SB540: Online Internet Safety; certain disclosures related to conversational AI services; require passed 2026-05-11

    This law requires operators of AI companion chatbots to disclose that users are interacting with an AI rather than a person, to verify age before allowing sexually explicit features, to protect minor users from harmful content and manipulative engagement techniques, and to adopt crisis response protocols. It also requires public disclosure of crisis referral data and parental tools for minor accounts. The Attorney General may enforce with civil penalties, damages, and injunctions.

  • SR789: Senate Study Committee on the Impact of Artificial Intelligence; create passed 2026-03-31

    Creates the Senate Study Committee on the Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Creative Industries. The committee must study conditions, needs, issues, and problems related to artificial intelligence in creative industries and recommend any action or legislation it deems necessary or appropriate.

  • SR431: Senate Impact of Social Media and Artificial Intelligence on Children and Platform Privacy Protection Study Committee; create passed 2025-04-02

    Creates the Senate Impact of Social Media and Artificial Intelligence on Children and Platform Privacy Protection Study Committee to study the conditions, needs, issues, and problems related to social media and artificial intelligence impacts on children and platform privacy, and to recommend any action or legislation the committee deems necessary or appropriate.

  • SR391: Senate Study Committee on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Currency; create passed 2025-04-02

    Creates the Senate Study Committee on Artificial Intelligence and Digital Currency to study conditions, needs, issues, and problems related to AI and digital currency and to recommend any action or legislation the committee deems necessary or appropriate (paragraphs 1 and 3).

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Georgia. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
